Somnucor · the Tower Plaza
Welcome to Somnucor

Somnucor · the Arrival Hub. Everyone who comes to the city lands here. The gate to the Hall of Doors is right here, on the east wall between the pads; the hologram over the map plays short tutorials through the day. Walk out through the doors ahead and the Tower is straight in front of you. The concierge at the desk on your left will help with anything, and the Overlook is behind you.
You wake on a pad in the Arrival Hub. (Take a door of your own in the Hall and it is there you will wake.)
Ione, the Arrivals Concierge
Welcome to Somnucor. I'm Ione, the concierge here at the Arrival Hub. Where would you like to go first?
at the concierge desk in the Arrival Hub
Ione, the Arrivals Concierge · press E or tap to talk
You came in on one of the four pads. The doors ahead open on the Tower Plaza; the whole city falls away below it in nine rings.
W A S D to walk, Shift to run, click and move the mouse to look round. On a phone: left thumb to walk, drag to look. Esc goes back.
Walk up to a door, a person or a booth and a line comes up at the bottom. Press E, click the line, or tap Use on a phone. Doors never open by walking into them.
Its gate is right here, on the east wall between the pads. Every world has a door in the Hall, and every dreamer can take a door of their own.
Menu, then My door: choose its size, its shape and its type, then dress it as you like. It stands in the Hall for everyone to see.
The people of Somnucor talk back. Walk up to someone and press E to speak. Ione, at the desk by the doors, will help with anything.
Press the circle and talk, or type. A sentence is enough: the Atlas builds only what you dreamt, and what you left out stays faint.
Changing what is wrong
Tap anything in your dream to open it: its colours, its materials, its windows and doors, who lives there. All of it yours to correct.
From anywhere, Menu then My dream takes you back to your own dream. The land, in the Menu, lists every place you can go.
Your dreams are yours
They stay on your device. Keep them to your account and they are locked first, with a phrase only you know.
Out of the back of this hub the deck reaches over the water: all of Somnucor below you. A good place to get your bearings.
